rationale: The Skia mask-image url() parser no longer treats fragment (#id) or data: references as file paths; it returns no mask for them, as it already did for an unreadable file. The bridge confines every file reference before it reaches the canvas, so this only removes a filesystem lookup for references that never named a file. No canvas API, signature or authority boundary changes. Pulp-side hardening alongside the retained-UI kernel event; Vellum may adopt it independently.
